messages:
DeployBot: Starting deploy to production (us-west-2) - tag `v1.8.2-rc3`, commit `abcdef1234`. Change window: 30m. Running migration group `schema_migrate_2026_03_20` (chunked runner, concurrency=4). Jobs: schema.users.add_billing_columns, schema.orders.backfill_indexes (chunks=12), schema.kv.safe_compact. Estimated affected rows: ~2.1M. Will stream progress here.

Maya: thanks — is this on the canary subset first? :eyes:

DeployBot: Yes, canary subset = 2% traffic on prod. Will run migrations on canary instances first (chunks 1-2).

Sam: noted. I'll watch the backfills. If any chunk >5% errors we pause and escalate.

OpsBot: schema.orders.backfill_indexes chunk=1 started on host i-0a3de.. pid=4421
OpsBot: chunk=1 progress: 0% -> 18% (rows processed: 39,200)

Ryan: tagging `release-2026-03-20` in case we need a quick pin.

Kevin: can we confirm autovacuum is disabled for this table on the backfill nodes? Last time we saw bloat.

Maya: yes, autovacuum disabled via session override on worker pool.

OpsBot: schema.users.add_billing_columns started (migrate step 1/3) - applying DDL on canary shard

OpsBot: schema.orders.backfill_indexes chunk=2 progress: 0% -> 64% (rows: 132,800)

Sam: chunk 2 looks healthy. continuing.

OpsBot: schema.kv.safe_compact running on shard-3 (low-priority)

OpsBot: schema.orders.backfill_indexes chunk=3 failed (constraint violation) - sample error: `duplicate key value violates unique constraint "orders_pkey"`

Maya: @Sam can you cat the failing rows? we might have duplicate external ids from earlier ingest.

Sam: looking now. quick check: the failing chunk contains ~120 rows with duplicate ext_id. I can filter and rerun with dedupe step.

Ryan: since it's canary only, hold the rollout until the dedupe patch is applied to the chunk runner. No rollback for the whole deploy yet.

DeployBot: Pausing migration group `schema_migrate_2026_03_20` after chunk failure. Canary traffic unaffected.

Sam: patch prepared: add dedupe_before_insert flag to chunk runner, will run patch on chunk=3 only. Estimated 4m.

Kevin: run it with `--dry-run` first? but if it's just dedupe and idempotent, ok to proceed.

Sam: executed dry-run: dedupe matched 118 rows, no schema changes. proceeding with real run.

OpsBot: retry schema.orders.backfill_indexes chunk=3 progress: 0% -> 100% (rows: 88,720) - dedupe applied

Maya: nice. Any signal to continue full rollout?

Ryan: proceed to run remaining chunks on canary. if next 3 chunks OK, we promote to 10% traffic.

OpsBot: canary chunks 4-6 started

OpsBot: schema.users.add_billing_columns step 2/3 completed on canary

OpsBot: canary chunks 4-6 progress: all under 2% errors, average throughput 1.2k rows/s

DeployBot: Canary pass criteria met. Promoting to 10% traffic and continuing migrations across production shards.

Maya: tagging ops runbook PR-234 in case we need quick rollback steps.

Sam: starting chunked run across prod shards (chunks 7-12). Running windowed concurrency=4.

OpsBot: prod chunk=7 started (host i-0b4fc..), chunk=8 scheduled

OpsBot: prod chunk=7 progress: 0% -> 47% (rows: 210,600)

DeployBot: Migration group `schema_migrate_2026_03_20` finished: all jobs completed. Summary: total rows touched 2,138,972; errors reconciled (dedupe) 118 rows; downtime: none.

Maya: awesome — thanks for the quick patch @Sam and for the clear status updates. :tada:

Ryan: will pin `release-2026-03-20` to prod tag `v1.8.2` and push release notes.

DeployBot: Deploy finished successfully. Release note draft: "Add billing columns, index backfills completed with dedupe on orders, safe compaction of kv store".

Kevin: I'll schedule a light verification scan overnight for index health.

Sam: leaving a short note in the migration job: `dedupe applied chunk=3 for duplicate ext_id` for future audits.

Maya: closing the change window early. If anyone sees anomalies ping #incidents.
